packet_dag.terminal_condition: REQ-20260711-001 through REQ-20260711-009 have terminal statuses with proof or precise blockers.

title: One Time owner experience, CRM, and landing corrective implementation

reasons: The packet asks for production-quality corrections across owner shell, CRM, public landing, signup, onboarding, verification, PR, and deploy gates.
The packet explicitly says implementation, not audit-only, but requires raw capture, run setup, current-state audit, and proof before Done.
Several requested actions are external-provider writes and must be blocked or no-send.
affected_product_surfaces: Operations generated artifact and One Time public onboarding handoff

operator_intent_summary: Correct the actual One Time owner/admin experience so Rabbi Scheller uses the shared Operations shell scoped to One Time, the CRM is first-party and usable, the public landing/signup/onboarding journey matches approved copy and no-send policy, and evidence replaces false Done labels.
raw_quotes: Direct /operations.html proof does not prove canonical /operations.
No email / WhatsApp / Telegram / campaign sends.
Use the latest approved full-body Robot asset.

decisions_captured.decision: External sends, imports, charges, access grants, DNS, and provider writes are blocked in this packet.
Robot Scheller source resolved to the latest downloaded local image and should be fit inside the launcher bubble without destructive crop.
Deployment after PR is blocked until review approval.

out_of_scope: No email, WhatsApp, Telegram, campaign, payment, charge, refund, access grant, DNS, contact import, or external CRM/provider mutation.
No raw private contact exports, secrets, or private student/contact bodies committed.
No production deployment before the approved review gate.

known_current_defects: No generated Operations artifact drift command.
Direct operations.html remains a user-reachable source page.
Public lead capture can attempt Telegram reminder.
One Time config still has stale public CTA contract.
Signup continuation page still says preview/TBD/checklist.
Robot Scheller approved image is not imported under the referenced asset path.
current_state.before_screenshot_plan: Source-level audit exists now; after implementation, capture desktop/mobile route screenshots and modal/onboarding states.

expanded_phrases.production-quality: Code changes, generated asset drift gate, screenshots, tests, registries, PR, deployment gate, and live-smoke proof or blocker.
expanded_phrases.first-party operational CRM: Local BNA/One Time CRM records, notes, follow-ups, stages, tags, timeline, mailbox linkage, and blocked external sends/imports.
expanded_phrases.premium visual brief: Exact public hierarchy, clean responsive UI, no stale CTAs, no placeholder public social/media claims, and Robot Scheller asset fit.
expanded_phrases.CRM: First-party One Time lead and contact records only, with no GHL, LeadConnector, external import, or external send in this packet.

requirements.expected_result: The broad corrective packet is registered and executable with validator-backed requirements.

requirements.statement: Add Operations generated artifact build/check and canonical route proof.
requirements.expected_result: Canonical /operations evidence uses generated bootstrap assets and drift is gated.

requirements.statement: Correct the public landing/signup/onboarding journey, including Robot Scheller asset and no-send guardrails.
requirements.expected_result: Public users see approved copy and enter a real no-send onboarding flow linked to the CRM lead.

criteria: Raw intake, run, register, surface map, control tower, and current-state audit exist.
